model: Finite positive-energy CFT state with nonlinear local Einstein-Maxwell-Polyakov geometry on a characteristic diamond

conventions.metric: ds4^2=-exp(2sigma)du dv+R^2 dOmega^2; re=1; u=t+x,v=t-x; durations in re/c
conventions.quantum_stress: t2_uu=q/(12pi)*(sigma_uu-sigma_u^2+t_u); t2_vv analogously; t2_uv=-q*sigma_uv/(12pi); p_perp=0; k=Gq/(12pi)=alpha/3
conventions.finite_state: V(u)=u+amplitude*delay*B((u-start)/delay), B=exp(4-1/[z*(1-z)]) inside(0,1), zero otherwise in the first conformal period; degree-one periodic extension of period2pi/Omega outside this local diamond

source: Exact t_u=-Omega^2/4+(3/2)*_exterior_quantum_seed(u-start,amplitude,delay); t_v=-Omega^2/4. Finite initial CFT-state energy retained; state amplitude is not linearized

equations.edge: Z=0 on both initial null rays is coordinate gauge; on v=0 solve Y_uu=alpha*Y_u^2/(2S)+2*sigmabar_u*Y_u-(2/3)*(sigmabar_uu-sigmabar_u^2+t_u), with static corner value/slope; u=0 remains static
equations.stability: Subtract static equations algebraically using log1p/expm1; no subtraction of nearly equal unscaled lapse/radius fields before division by alpha
equations.comparison: Geometry-linearized response uses the SAME exact finite t_u perturbation and the same static alpha background; this is not the earlier infinitesimal-state benchmark

nonlinear_scaling.interpretation: Larger-alpha nonlinear geometry remainders exceed both solution discretization differences and halve approximately with alpha. The tiny physical-alpha remainder is below the total solution mesh difference; its paired-grid difference is recorded but is not a certified continuum nonlinear correction

local_clock_scope: Prescribed accelerated conformal-coordinate curves x=+.2 and x=-.2; null launch t=.4, ideal reflection t=.8, return t=1.2. Proper elapsed time is integrated on the SAME x=+.2 emitter/receiver curve, in re/c units. Causal by construction; no material mouths, exterior clock identification or time-travel test
local_clock_linear_comparison: The exact proper-time functional is evaluated on the geometry-linearized conformal field; this is not truncation of the clock functional itself to first order
scope: The initial data ASSUME an existing calibrated throat; this does not model throat formation from ordinary space. Local prescribed finite CFT state and conditional radius-independent Polyakov action. Not the eta4 circulating history: coordinate gauge, incoming-data prescription and absent exterior feedback differ. Larger-alpha cases are numerical controls, not validated designs. No physical state preparation, full4D renormalized matter completion, global matching, stability or chronology claim
sources: https://arxiv.org/pdf/math-ph/0412028 (Fewster-Hollands conformal stress transformation, Eqs2.9 and3.41)
The normalized nonlinear diamond and same-source comparison are our application of this conditional model
